reader.notes: MidrangeScaled returns (MaxScaled + MinScaled) x 5 at scale+1 through checked ExactAdd/ExactMul, so the halving is exact and an overflow is a size error, never a wrap; the COBOL-85 18-digit maximum stays far inside Int128. Same output at --std 2023.
